tool_summary: Substitutes the current user identity, typically to root, for a new shell or command.
platform_notes: Flag set is broadly consistent across GNU/Linux and BSD/macOS su for the purposes of this ruleset.

rules.description: Any invocation of su switches the effective user identity, defaulting to root when no user is specified. A subsequent shell or command runs under the new identity with that identity's full privileges.
rules.reversible_note: Reversibility depends entirely on what is done in the resulting session, which commandant does not inspect. Treated as the worst case.
rules.notes: Blanket-flags all invocations; the switched-to session is opaque to commandant. Bare su defaults to root on most systems.
